expression.original: Self-reference at genesis: the field's first contents are the claims of the document that specifies the field. The rules used to test the claims are derived from the claims being tested.
expression.elaboration: Per CLM-0014 this is a correlated-error risk: consensus of field with document is not accuracy. Mitigation path: admit differently-situated observers and external grounding (braided verification). Reopening condition: first accepted contribution from an observer independent of OBS-DOC-0001.
